notes.title: 18 games the PC Gamer team can't wait to play in 2025
notes.content:
🌟 Exciting News! Bogdan’s Cross Among PC Gamer’s 18 Most Anticipated Titles of 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046518/d83c14811907b10702f918f5105cea664d750b12.jpg[/img]

We are beyond thrilled to share that Bogdan’s Cross has been recognized by PC Gamer as one of the 18 Most Anticipated Titles for 2025! 🎉 This incredible honor fuels our passion and excitement to bring this project to life for you.

This recognition highlights the effort, creativity, and heart that's gone into crafting Bogdan's Cross, a journey through a reimagined Crusade-era world filled with mystery, faith, and redemption. 🛡️✨

Read the full article from PC GAMER here:
https://www.pcgamer.com/games/18-games-the-pc-gamer-team-cant-wait-to-play-in-2025/

📖 If you haven’t already, don’t forget to add Bogdan’s Cross to your Steam wishlist and be the first to know about updates, announcements, and the upcoming demo!

notes.title: Featured in EDGE Magazine
notes.content:
[h1]🌟 Exciting News: Bogdan's Cross Featured in EDGE Magazine![/h1]

[h2]As a solo developer, it’s an incredible honor to share that Bogdan’s Cross was recently featured in EDGE magazine! This recognition marks a huge milestone for me and for the game itself.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046518/ed0e9c37c5b5f70dc268febb7b0114a35e9e74ac.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046518/2e05aff040aa2c857d84b19993c7f9ff0666a62c.jpg[/img]

EDGE highlighted the unique world of Bogdan's Cross, from its deeply immersive narrative and hand-crafted visuals made with Quill and Unreal Engine to the faith that drives the heart of the story. Seeing Bogdan's Cross resonating with both players and the gaming community is beyond rewarding.

💬 What’s next? I’m excited to bring you more updates, gameplay showcases, and insight into the making of the game as we inch closer to release. Your support fuels this journey and means everything to me!

👉 Haven’t added Bogdan’s Cross to your wishlist yet? Be sure to hit that wishlist button and follow the game for all the latest updates and behind-the-scenes sneak peeks.

Thank you for being part of this journey. Stay tuned for more exciting news to come!

You can check the magazines edition here:

https://www.magazinesdirect.com/az-single-issues/6936949/edge-magazine-single-issue.thtml

notes.title: Bogdan's Cross is a game about a Templar knight struggling with his faith, only he's a literal giant teddy bear
notes.content: Bogdan's Cross is an action-adventure tale of a humble shepherd turned legendary Templar knight amidst the terrible time of the Crusades. "Traverse stunning landscapes, uncover hidden tales and mysteries, and confront shadows of doubt and despair," the Steam page says, before slipping in the load-bearing caveat: "While grounded in historical accuracy, the game takes creative liberties to weave a captivating fictional narrative.".. Read more.
